story: The onboarding coordinator checks the current status for E-500 (40% complete), then updates two pending tasks (Buddy Assignment and Orientation Scheduling) to completed, and finally checks the status again to confirm progress. This tests the agent's ability to track task IDs from the status response and use them in updates, plus verify the changes afterward.

args.notes: All orientation sessions scheduled for Aug 1-5
